description: Main window: core IPC, showing the window once the page has its theme, its title (the open repo and branch, for the Window menu and Mission Control), window theme (follows the Light/Dark setting), webview zoom (the Interface scale setting) + native open-folder / confirm dialogs, the Dock badge (how many agents in the terminals wait for the user). All file and git access goes through our own commands, which are confined to the opened repo.
